summary: regex_findall parameters: input string, regex, ignorecase and multiline flags (both default false).
questions: How do I make regex_findall case-insensitive?
How do I match across multiple lines with regex_findall?

answer_card.title: regex_findall parameters
answer_card.answer_md:
- `_input` (str, required)
- `_regex`: the pattern
- `ignorecase` (default false)
- `multiline` (default false): search across line endings
